title: Grab the A16 iPad for $379 in this rockbottom Black Friday sale
content:
Macworld

Apple iPad A16

View Deal

‘Tis the season for shopping, and if you’re looking for a new iPad, now’s the time to grab one. Amazon is selling the A16 iPad for $379, the best price we’ve seen since the June price hikes.

Even though this is about $100 more than it was last Black Friday, it still gets our fill fledged recommendation. Apple’s entry-level tablet features a gorgeous Liquid Retina display that’s sharp and vibrant, making everything look beautiful, from watching movies to playing games and reading books. In fact, the screen is one of our favorite things about this tablet, especially since it’s the cheapest tablet Apple sells.

The iPad also features an A16 chip that can handle games, video editing, and switching between apps with ease. You won’t get Apple Intelligence, but you probably won’t miss it, and you can always install one of the many AI apps available in the App Store if you want. And since it only has 128GB of storage space, you’ll probably be happy reclaiming the space reserved for Apple’s AI tools.

So go grab the A16 iPad for $379 before Black Friday ends and the price jumps back up.
